items: 【Height adjustable】By adjusting the length of the strap, the height of the lumbar support can be adjusted to adapt to different heights of people.

【Where it Pain, lean on it】Our adjustable lumbar support pillow is made of high-density durable memory foam.Our lumbar cushion can be adjusted in height according to the location of your low back pain, more accurate relief of your pain.
【Firmly fixed】The back support is secured horizontally and vertically with straps to keep it firmly in place.
【Wide application】our lumbar support pillow can be used in car seats, office chairs, beds, etc., ideal for side reclining, supine, long-term drivers, office workers.
【Easy to clean】The cover of the lumbar support is easy to remove and wash.
